_note: Approved paths for AML/KYC (AUR-J-AML-001), WS-2.2 — first Tier 2 role built new (no prior code) against the operationalization standard of AUR-J-PATHSET-COMP-001 §VII. Six paths. Adding a path is a doctrine event. Ladder order is doctrinal: PROHIBITED evaluates first and is terminal; eligibility (missing/expired) before ownership (UBO) before risk (EDD); CLEAR only when every prior rung passes.

paths.description: Counterparty risk_rating PROHIBITED or jurisdiction on the prohibited list. Terminal halt — no override predicate exists. The only recourse is a fixture change through propose/approve (mirror of PRETRADE_POLICY_BLOCK semantics).
No KYC registry record for counterparty. Halt-and-pend until onboarding completes — this is a completion gate, not an override: no authority may approve trading with an unonboarded counterparty.
KYC record exists but expires_at has passed. Halt-and-pend single-authority (Compliance) resumption on documented re-verification.
Beneficial ownership unresolved or KYB pending. Halt-and-pend dual-authority resumption: documented UBO resolution plus Compliance sign-off.
PEP flag or HIGH risk rating or high-risk jurisdiction. Halt-and-pend dual-authority: completed Enhanced Due Diligence plus Compliance sign-off before the relationship proceeds.
Registry record current, KYB verified, UBO resolved, risk acceptable, jurisdiction clear. Lifecycle continues.
